bisect_trajectory: run a binary search to minimize a CompilerEnv trajectory by removing the suffix or prefix
random_minimization: run iterative random action removal to minimize a CompilerEnv trajectory while a hypothesis holds
minimize_trajectory_iteratively: run iterative single-action removal to find the minimal CompilerEnv trajectory that still triggers a hypothesis
environment_validation_fails: create a hypothesis callback that returns true when a CompilerEnv validation fails
MinimizationError: handle MinimizationError exceptions raised when trajectory minimization fails or action replay errors occur
